Class ListStationController

java.lang.Object
controller.ListStationController
public class ListStationController extends Object

  • Method Details

    • setScenario

      public void setScenario(Scenario scenario)
      Sets the current scenario to the provided scenario and loads the associated stations. This method updates the currentScenario field to the specified scenario and proceeds to call the loadStations method to populate the station list UI component with data relevant to the scenario.
      Parameters:
      scenario - the scenario to set as the current active scenario

    • getStations

      public List<StationDTO> getStations()
      Retrieves a list of station DTOs associated with the current scenario. This method filters the stations available in the system to include only those that belong to the scenario currently set as active. If the current scenario is not set (null), an error message is displayed, and an empty list is returned.
      Returns:
      a list of StationDTO objects associated with the active scenario, or an empty list if the current scenario is null or no matching stations are found

    • getBuildingByStation

      public List<Building> getBuildingByStation(Station station)
      Retrieves a list of buildings associated with a specific station. This method filters the available buildings to include only those that are associated with the given station. The filtering is performed by comparing the station of each building to the provided station.
      Parameters:
      station - the station whose associated buildings are to be retrieved
      Returns:
      a list of buildings that are associated with the specified station

    • ShowStationDescription

      public void ShowStationDescription()
      Displays the description of the selected station in the UI. This method retrieves the currently selected station from the station list UI component and displays its details, such as name, coordinates, type, and cargo capacity, in a textual format. If no station is selected, a message prompting the user to select a station is displayed instead. Additionally, if the selected station has associated buildings, a list of those buildings is appended to the description. Behavior: - If no station is selected, displays a message requesting the user to make a selection. - If a station is selected, displays its name, coordinates, type, and cargo capacity. - Retrieves and displays the building information associated with the selected station, if any. Preconditions: - The `StationList` UI component must be populated with a list of stations. - `StationDescription` must be initialized as the output text area or field for station details. - `getBuildingByStation` must return a list of buildings corresponding to the given station. Error Handling: - If no station is selected, a default message is displayed instead of station details.

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller after its root element has been completely loaded. This method is automatically called by the JavaFX framework following the loading of the FXML file. It serves as the entry point for initializing any user interface components, bindings, event handlers, or other setup tasks required for the controller's operation. Intended Functionality: - Set up UI elements and event handlers. - Initialize internal state or data relevant to the controller. - May include calls to methods for additional setup processes or data loading. Note: This method is invoked once, ensuring that the controller's environment is fully initialized and ready for interaction.

    • returnToMenu

      public void returnToMenu()
      Returns the user to the main menu by closing the current stage. This method handles navigation from the current UI to the main menu. It retrieves the stage associated with the `ListStations` UI component and closes it, effectively ending the current view. Behavior: - Retrieves the current stage using `ListStations`. - Closes the stage if it exists. Preconditions: - The `ListStations` UI component must have an active scene attached to a stage. Error Handling: - If the current stage is null, no action is performed.
